text:
Leonora Neuffer Bilger received the Francis P. Garvan–John M. Olin Medal in 1953. The Wikipedia recipient list gives "1953 Leonora N. Bilger," and an Iowa State finding aid also lists her under 1953. The shared note's alternatives don't fit: 1947 went to Mary Lura Sherrill and 1961 to Sarah Ratner.

Sources:
- [Garvan–Olin Medal, Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Garvan%E2%80%93Olin_Medal)
- [Garvan Medal survey files, Iowa State University](https://findingaids.lib.iastate.edu/spcl/manuscripts/MS678.html)

CONFIDENCE: 95
